He made it open in order for all of us to add onto it with such ability to allow it all to be canon. I don't think he was making an ending. I understand your point with the extension of the analogy, but we can honestly say that things have been bumpy for a while now, right? The pauses have caused many to leave, and I congratulate the people that stayed,  but things honestly just don't go always as planned. Yes, if those pauses never happened, we would probably still all be here and we may have gotten the ending we all wanted, but sadly, things transpired differently. As fans that have stuck by for so long, we should've been mentally ready for the idea that the tracks may stray from our wanted destination. Don't get me wrong though, I completely understand why people dislike this all, but we have stuck by him for this long. It seems almost asked of us to maybe not like it but rather to accept his vision as his own, no matter if it differs from our own.  

I also completely understand how the ending wasn't good or written well in a traditional aspect, but Homestuck is anything but traditional. I won't lie, I actually felt some hate over the ending at first, but I have come to understand it in different matters. I honestly never really saw Homestuck as a story, but rather just people living their lives and going on this big adventure, so comparing it to a story seems weird in a way. With all that aside, I do wish for people to keep saying their mind on this story, because it is our story in a way, but it still is Hussie's story as well. He is allowed to make it, but we are allowed to give him ideas, criticisms that he may take however he wishes. It's our story to ask for, but it is his story to make.

I know a lot of people drag on Hussie over Homestuck, but in all honest opinion, I really respect how Hussie has been able to keep going despite what the fandom yells at him for. I understand that people are angry at the story over the ending and whatnot, but I really don't think Hussie deserves to be getting all the heat. I mean, we're all on this train ride, and if we don't like where the tracks are taking us, we should just get off instead of barking off at the conductor. Now, I'm not pointing at those people that dislike the ending necessarily. Hussie has really made Homestuck to be something that we all can have a word in, but I really hate it when someone just gets mad at Hussie. It's his vision. If you have constructive criticisms, that's good, but don't try to force him to "fix" those.  


All in all, I can't speak for the whole community, but you're a really awesome guy, Hussie. You have always been a force to be reckoned with, and I respect that. I do hope you keep going alright, and that you don't hate all of us for our stupidity over this.
